item.title: Auditing domain alignment in latent representations for cross-domain materials machine learning
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Henry R N B Enninful
Machine learning (ML) models for materials discovery increasingly combine heterogeneous experimental and computational datasets, yet it remains unclear whether learned representations capture transferable structure–property relationships or primarily encode domain-specific biases. Here, we audit domain alignment in latent representations for cross-domain materials ML using experimentally measured porous carbons, experimentally measured metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), and simulated MOFs. A target-free neural encoder was trained on shared physicochemical descriptors with explicit missingness masks, while domain-adversarial and noise-consistency objectives were used to examine how alignment reshapes latent-space geometry. Across the alignment grid, the learned representations exhibited part…

item.title: 面向电极材料的机器学习：基于组成的性质预测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hao Wu, Cameron Hargreaves, Arpit Mishra, Gian-Marco Rignanese
该工作基于 Materials Project Battery Explorer 数据集，比较了 MODNet、CrabNet 和基于 Magpie 特征的随机森林模型在电池电极材料性质预测中的表现。作者通过预测精度、二维嵌入可视化、bootstrap 重采样、两种交叉验证策略以及实验留出数据进行评估，发现 CrabNet 在各项测试中总体表现最佳。研究还利用 t-SNE 和 DBSCAN 对物理特征进行无监督聚类，显示材料可在无标签条件下形成有意义分组，所选模型可作为早期电极材料组成筛选工具。

arXiv:2512.03829v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable operation of high-power proton cyclotrons is a critical requirement for Accelerator Driven Systems (ADS) and other large-scale applications. arXiv:2507.22854v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose novel classical and quantum online algorithms for learning finite- and infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). While reinforcement learning (RL) holds promise for autonomously acquiring robot control policies, scaling it to high-DoF embodiments remains challenging. item.title: Learning Standard Model structure from LHC data with Riemannian flow matching
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Midori Kato, Kevin A. Urquía-Calderón, Inar Timiryasov, Oleg Ruchayskiy
arXiv:2607.16144v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work we demonstrate that a single transformer-based generative model can capture Standard Model structure spanning five decades of invariant mass, from the sub-GeV regime to the TeV continuum, a range that no single Monte Carlo sample covers.
